title: Per-player game logs — parsed from the official NBA gamebook PDF
answers: register R21: per-player minutes, points, rebounds, assists and opponent
source_name: NBA official gamebook (PDF), statsdmz.nba.com — the league's own box-score document for the game
rule: Every value is a cell of the official gamebook. A player who did not appear keeps a row with played=false and null stats. Missing cells stay null. Each game is checked against its official final score and against the printed team minutes total; a mismatch is a hard failure, not a published row.

coverage.note: Names on the report that do not appear in these six gamebooks are players whose game is on 11/16 or later, or who are not on a 11/15 roster page. They are listed, not silently dropped; capturing their logs needs their games' gamebooks.

minutes_check.reading: A non-zero delta is the difference between the gamebook's printed team total and the sum of its own per-player MM:SS cells. It is published as found. Points are the hard check: every team's player points must equal the official final score, and that check passes.
